title: lifecycle.rs extract_header_value duplicates the same function from commands/post.rs
description:
## What / Why
The private function extract_header_value() appears in both crates/reader/src/session/lifecycle.rs (line ~1258) and crates/reader/src/session/commands/post.rs (line ~150). They are identical in behavior (case-insensitive prefix search). Having two copies creates drift risk.

## Fix
Move extract_header_value() to a shared module (e.g. crates/reader/src/post/mod.rs or a new header_utils.rs) and have both callers import it from there.
